commits.subject: Set UnderlinePosition so the build gets the release's -249
commits.body: The released style has post.underlinePosition -249 and underlineThickness 99. It was exported by a FontForge built 2019-03-13 (the FFTM table of the TTF at 92acf3b, before the ttx fixes of d6c8d9b), which applies the rule of FontForge's tag 20190317: UnderlinePosition + UnderlineWidth/2, truncated toward zero, so -299 became -249. These sources are converted with babelfont's --fontforge-underline-position, the rule of FontForge's exporter up to tag 20170731: position - width/2, which turns -299 into -348. UnderlinePosition -200 is the value that rule turns into the release's -249 (-200 - 49.5 = -249.5, truncated); UnderlineWidth stays 99. The build's underline is the release's (top -249, 99 thick); the number stated here is no longer its centre, which is what FontForge's UnderlinePosition means.
